name: Voodoo
overview: Scripture firmly forbids involvement with practices related to Voodoo, including enchantments, divination, and seeking guidance from familiar spirits or wizards, as these defile the believer and provoke God's judgment. The Old Testament commands God’s people to avoid such occult practices, warning that those who turn to them will be cut off from the community. Instead, believers are called to dwell securely under the protection of the Almighty, finding refuge in Him alone rather than in forbidden spiritual arts.
